hero.title: Invest in Thailand with legal clarity
hero.subtitle: A regulated introduction platform connecting Thai majority investors (51%) with foreign entrepreneurs — viable business plans and lawyer-reviewed joint ventures.

sectionInvestors.title: For Thai investors
sectionInvestors.body: Become the majority shareholder in innovative international concepts. Full legal protection through joint-venture agreements drafted by licensed law firms.

sectionEntrepreneurs.title: For foreign entrepreneurs
sectionEntrepreneurs.body: Step out of the shadow of nominee structures. Find a real local partner to stabilise your business and obtain genuine ownership rights.

trust.title: Verification & compliance first
trust.body: Profiles and legal compliance are strictly verified so Thai investors can trust the structure, and entrepreneurs know agreements meet Thai regulatory expectations.
